σώφρων, -ον
[in LXX: 4Ma.9:1-32 * ;]
__(a) of sound mind, sane, sensible;
__(b) self-controlled, sober-minded: 1Ti.3:2, Tit.1:8 2:2, 5 (Arist.).†

strongs.def: safe (sound) in mind, i.e. self-controlled (moderate as to opinion or passion)
strongs.from: from the base of G4982 (σώζω) and that of G5424 (φρήν)
